method.description: Actually visually inspected four chronological sheets using view_image, every fourth frame plus last, against individually viewed exact-hash approved source. FFmpeg decoding limited to two CPU threads; no GPU submission or painting processor. Live Comfy history verified successful generation.

observations: Hedgehog gently turns and leans down toward the apple during roughly frames 12-32 while lowering its held yellow leaf. This is a meaningful small action; later samples largely hold the sniffing pose rather than repeating the movement.

Head, snout, ears, visible arm and spiny back remain coherent through the turn. Leaf naturally occludes parts of the lower body/feet in the bent pose; no detached, duplicated or malformed limbs observed.
Brown spines, tan face/body, orange cheeks, turquoise scarf and yellow leaf preserve the source identity. Scarf remains attached and the leaf remains visibly held.

Red apple with stem/leaf, purple-capped orange-stemmed mushroom and green grass persist, without added faces. Entire composition remains uncropped with generous margins; no disappearing decorations or unintended object morphing observed.
limitations: Sampled visual inspection is not realtime playback or inspection of every frame. Sampling cannot guarantee frame-perfect smoothness, absence of inter-sample artifacts or seamless looping.
scope: Exact-MP4 sampled visual reward-video gate only. Does not approve processed painting assets or integration.
